summary: Shows passing the API token with --token on ansible-galaxy, with the server taken from --server, the default Galaxy URL, or a GALAXY_SERVER setting, and warns this is insecure.
questions: How do I publish a collection with a token passed on the command line?
How do I choose the server when using --token?

answer_card.title: Pass the token on the command line
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-galaxy collection publish path/to/my_namespace-my_collection-1.0.0.tar.gz --token <token>
```
The server comes from `--server`, the default `https://galaxy.ansible.com`, or a `GALAXY_SERVER` setting in `ansible.cfg`. This is **insecure**: command-line secrets may be visible to others.
